name: reg_hive_query
description: Query a Windows registry hive file (regipy) and return a key's values and subkey names as JSON.

hive.description: Path to the extracted hive file (SOFTWARE, SYSTEM, NTUSER.DAT, ...)

key.description: Registry key path, e.g. Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion

list_subkeys.description: Also list immediate subkey names (default true)
